description: This file defines the FundNotFoundException class, a custom exception used in the Fineract project to indicate that a fund resource was not found.

classes.name: FundNotFoundException
classes.description: A RuntimeException subclass representing a 'fund resource not found' error, extending AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException.

methods.name: FundNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a specific fund ID.

methods.name: FundNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with a specific fund ID and an underlying data access exception.
